title: Open Server
description: Configuration-free module for hosted worlds. Clears the game pause when the world comes up, so a world (e.g. on Molten Hosting) never sits paused waiting for someone to press space. Also adds a per-user LANDING SCENE: flag a user and they log in to their own scene instead of the one active scene, so a party split survives a refresh. Install it, enable it, forget it.
